description.prompt: Create ONE independent high-resolution web hero object illustration (NOT an atlas, NOT a collage, NOT multiple panels). 1536 x 1536 square preferred. Subject: A single rice sack with an elegant little fruit fly hovering beside the tied opening; a short curved trail of three ochre scent dots. Style reference is the attached toucan graphic: use broad SOLID color masses, elegant simplified curved silhouettes and a few deliberate angular cutouts; flat mid-century editorial print, crisp vector-like edges. Palette: sage green, deep forest, warm cream and golden ochre. Transparent background, no scene, no rectangle, no card, no border. Optional one SMALL irregular pale flat patch behind the object. Object should occupy only central 70% of canvas with fully visible extremities and generous transparent margins. No words, gradients, realistic shadows, bevels, glossy shading, grain, watercolor texture or sticker outlines. Distinctive sophisticated illustration, not a generic emoji. This will be displayed at about 280 px, so clarity of the silhouette matters.
